import math
def control(obs):
    rails=obs['local_map']
    left=rails['left_rail']; right=rails['right_rail']
    mids=[((a[0]+b[0])*0.5,(a[1]+b[1])*0.5) for a,b in zip(left,right)]
    ahead=[p for p in mids if p[0]>0]
    if not ahead:
        return (0,0)
    look=3.6
    target=min(ahead,key=lambda p:abs(math.hypot(*p)-look))
    u,v=target
    curvature=2*v/max(2,u*u+v*v)
    desired=math.degrees(math.atan(3.65*curvature))
    desired=max(-36,min(36,desired))
    h=obs['hitch_deg']
    steer=max(-34,min(34,0.75*h+2.5*(h-desired)))
    speed=-0.7 if abs(h)<30 else -0.45
    return (steer,speed,180)

import math

def control(obs):
    m=obs.get('local_map',{})
    bay=m.get('bay_corners')
    if not bay or len(bay)<4:
        wake('Bay map unavailable')
        return (0,0,180)
    back=((bay[0][0]+bay[1][0])/2,(bay[0][1]+bay[1][1])/2)
    front=((bay[2][0]+bay[3][0])/2,(bay[2][1]+bay[3][1])/2)
    dx=back[0]-front[0]
    dy=back[1]-front[1]
    length=math.hypot(dx,dy)
    dx/=length
    dy/=length
    along=-front[0]*dx-front[1]*dy
    x=front[0]+(along+9)*dx
    y=front[1]+(along+9)*dy
    h=math.radians(obs['hitch_deg'])
    k=2*y/max(15,x*x+y*y+3.8*x)
    desired=math.asin(max(-0.65,min(0.65,10.2*k)))
    steer=math.degrees(math.atan(3.9*(math.sin(h)/10.55+0.30*(h-desired))))
    steer=max(-42,min(42,steer))
    if abs(h)>1.02:
        wake('Hitch needs recovery')
        return (steer,0,180)
    return (steer,-0.85,180)
